posts.community: Apsis Aerocom Ltd - A High-Precision Bet on India’s Defense & Aerospace Manufacturing
posts.text: Recently the defense ministry has notified 6th positive indigenization list containing 405 strategically important defense items with an estimated business potential of Rs.3070 crs, a move that seeks to reduce dependence on imports and give a push to local manufacturing. Now, it is to be seen how this government initiative would directly/indirectly benefit the companies in the times to come.
